note: POINTER + fallback (mirrors leak-gate-baselines.v1.json / tempdoc 683). Per-corpus leg_union_recall FLOORS project from `current_release` when the release carries a per-corpus `union_recall` section (composed by `jseval release` from runs with staged_recall_accounting projections). Until a release carries union_recall sections, `fallback_baselines` — measured via `union-recall-gate-derive` from staged_recall_accounting projections — governs. `jseval union-recall-gate` loads this via ratchet_kernel.load_baselines_doc + union_recall_gate.project_release_to_baselines; `union-recall-gate-derive` re-pins fallback_baselines. This is the representation-completeness FLOOR sibling of leak-gate's cascade-leak CEILING (tempdoc 699). Pinned corpora are REPRODUCIBLE: beir/scifact (BEIR auto-fetch) + golden/needle-burial-v1 (committed source under scripts/jseval/635-corpora/needle-burial-v1/, buildable via `jseval corpus-build`) — both in leak-gate's pin set. The pin set may grow to leak-gate's other reproducible corpora (mixed/enron-qa, mixed/legal-clerc-200) via further `union-recall-gate-derive` runs.
